name: Focus Rail
description: Calm railway puzzle game about timing, routing, and focus, made as an alternative to endless scrolling.
longDescription: Focus Rail is a railway puzzle game: you flip switches so every train reaches its matching station, across twelve lines that get harder as you go. I made it as an alternative to brain rot, a short game that asks for focus instead of endless scrolling. It is live on Google Play with ads and in-app purchases, and I localise it so it can grow in other markets through paid ads.
